run_model_inference: run the causal language model inference script with a model path and optional prompt file
load_model_and_tokenizer: load a causal language model and tokenizer from a model path with auto device selection
test_model_logits: test the model by running inference and printing top 5 predicted token logits
enable_torch_debugging: enable torch debugging hooks on all leaf modules of a model for inspection
summarize_model_config: summarize a model's configuration including vocab size, hidden size, and layer count
